name: Telemetry Monitor
tagline: Real-time decoding and visualization of binary packet streams from embedded hardware.
what: A desktop tool that ingests binary telemetry over TCP/UDP, decodes it against a user-defined packet schema, and renders a live KPI dashboard with per-channel plotting and a full CRC integrity pipeline.
hard: Achieving thread-safe packet ingestion at 4000+ packets/sec with >1000 bytes per packet without dropping frames or blocking the UI.
highlights: User-defined packet schema editor with preset and custom CRC algorithms.
Singleton service architecture with dedicated subservices for ingestion and connection management.
Auto-expanding KPI tiles and per-channel live plots.

name: Lab Inventory Management System
tagline: Inventory, orders, and task delegation for a synthetic-biology team.
what: A full-stack LIMS built for McMaster SynBio to manage lab inventory, orders, and task assignment, with server-side rendering and a uniform terminal-adjacent design.
hard: Modelling row-level security so members only see what they should while keeping the schema simple enough to maintain.
highlights: Supabase backend with RLS policies and authentication.
Next.js + TypeScript frontend with server-side components for fast routing.

name: Terminal Portfolio
tagline: The site you're looking at — a dependency-free terminal in the browser.
what: A keyboard-driven portfolio that renders like a shell. Commands are ES modules, content lives in JSON, and everything is clickable so it works without typing.
hard: Keeping it framework-free while staying discoverable — every command output doubles as clickable navigation.
highlights: No build step, no dependencies — just static files.
Tab completion, command history, and did-you-mean suggestions.
